scope: as-recorded authentic prospective SPX quote and conditional model; replay is not a new forecast, live trade, or verified profit

assumptions.fee_convention: caller-supplied effective acquisition surcharge scenario/bound, not native exchange base fee
assumptions.capital_budget_scope: hypothetical full provided capital; caller must apply concentration/reservation controls
assumptions.quantity_scope: continuous shares; minimum order/lot rules require independent verification

limitations: Supplied payout/cost bounds are research assumptions, not independently verified edge or calibration
Displayed liquidity and an assumed latency haircut do not prove a future fill or queue priority
Ask prices already include spread crossing; sweep impact is not an additional duplicate cost
Unknown entry or settlement costs produce null full net profit and ROI
No future liquidity replenishment, price improvement, leverage, or proportional capital scaling assumed
Resolution disputes, lockup duration, portfolio correlation and lot-size approval must be supplied by caller
No new accounts, orders, positions, realized profit or execution authority are created
